The run failed due to a single rule violation: **R-003 — "Install the fans before installing the power supplies."**

**Root cause:** The technician installed the power supplies before the fans, violating the required ordering. The first power supply insertion (EV-VID-011-O001, 00:12.9) occurred ~10 seconds before the first fan insertion (EV-VID-011-O003, 00:23.1), yielding a measured gap of **−10.
